baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication joins the plural ocular noun أَبْصَٰرُهَا directly to خَٰشِعَةٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concrete faculty of sight takes a bodily posture of lowering, stillness, and submission; an inwardly affected group becomes externally legible in its gaze.

activation_trace.role: Ocular seeing supplies the concrete eyes and gaze whose posture can be observed.
Lowering, submission, and bodily stillness assign the gaze its subdued posture.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely reports that eyes are present in a fearful scene.
changed_reading.after: The eyes themselves visibly enact submission through a lowered, stilled gaze.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَبْصَٰرُهَا activates both eyesight and the ب ص ر branch of inward discernment, while خَٰشِعَةٌ predicates subjection of that capacity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can humble not only the direction of the eyeballs but also the subjects' confidence in their own recognition and judgment: perceptual and epistemic mastery yield together.

activation_trace.role: Insight and verified inward recognition extend the eye-word into the faculty of discernment.
Subjection and stilling remove the discerning faculty's former autonomy and assurance.

changed_reading.before: Only the outward gaze is lowered.
changed_reading.after: Their very confidence in seeing, knowing, and assessing is brought into submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding palpitating hearts create an inside-to-outside circuit: internal convulsion becomes visible at the eyes, so their lowering is the somatic endpoint of an already trembling interior rather than an isolated gesture.

activation_trace.role: The visible ocular surface makes the preceding inner state externally readable.
Bodily lowering and stillness give the internal disturbance its outward terminal posture.
The heart as inward center supplies the hidden pole of the body-wide response.
Palpitation and disturbance supply the motion that resolves into a subdued gaze.

structural_cues: 79:8 immediately precedes 79:9, and the possessive -hā links the eyes to the bearers represented by the preceding hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward hearts, palpitation, adjacency, and possessed eyes; I supply the arrow from inner tremor to outward lowering. A live alternative is that heart and eye are parallel symptoms with no causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The eyes independently assume a humble posture.
changed_reading.after: The humbled gaze is the visible bodily discharge of the hearts' concealed convulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence turns ocular humility into a vertical and juridical reversal. Fear-with-awe is offered, a sign is made visible, transgression persists, and self-magnifying height is claimed before culpable seizure; the lowered eyes become the bodily opposite of refused insight and arrogated elevation.

activation_trace.role: Discernment anchors the reversal in a faculty that could have recognized what was shown.
Lowering and submission provide the low pole that answers the narrative's claimed height.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the moral trajectory that must be reversed.
The second mapped root preserves the same limit-crossing image as an alternate root resolution.
Fear joined with awe supplies the voluntary response offered before compulsory lowering.
Making something visible supplies the disclosed sign that eyesight and insight nevertheless fail to receive.
Self-magnification and arrogance establish the high pole overturned by خاشعة.
Being taken to account for guilt supplies the force that converts chosen height into imposed lowering.

structural_cues: 79:17-25 orders transgression, an invitation to fear, shown evidence, denial, a claim to highest lordship, and punitive seizure.
The focus predicate is grammatically low-facing, while the narrative claim in 79:24 is explicitly superlative and high-facing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered narrative and opposed branch images of awe, visibility, height, and lowering; I map that exemplary arc onto the anonymous eyes. The alternative is that the Pharaoh account illustrates warning without specifying the identity of the eyes in 79:9.

changed_reading.before: The gaze lowers from undifferentiated fear.
changed_reading.after: Its lowering also stages the forced reversal of self-exaltation and of sight that refused a disclosed sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, the concealed outcome is uncovered specifically for one who sees. Sight is therefore not removed from the scene; it is forced into full contact with an intensely blazing object, and the seeing subject's perceptual mastery collapses into submission.

activation_trace.role: The faculty of recognition anchors the model in what the eyes must apprehend rather than merely where they point.
Subjection marks the viewer's loss of command before the disclosed object.
Eye-seeing and insight make actual apprehension, not blindness, the endpoint of the disclosure.
Emergence and uncovering remove every shelter of ambiguity from the visual field.
The fire's fierce blaze supplies the overwhelming content before which sight is subdued.

structural_cues: 79:36 places the unveiled blaze and the seeing recipient in one compact clause.
79:9 predicates humility of the eyes themselves rather than saying that they fail to see.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering, intense fire, and seeing; I supply the arrow by which unavoidable clarity overpowers the viewer's epistemic stance. Shame or fear could lower the eyes independently of this visual overload.

changed_reading.before: Humbled eyes avoid or lose sight.
changed_reading.after: They are humbled because sight becomes unavoidable and the disclosed reality overmasters the one who sees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending distinguishes anticipatory fear and self-restraint from unrestrained inclination. That distinction makes خاشعة ethically ambivalent: lowered perception can be cultivated before the event as inward restraint, or imposed at the event as the visible exposure of a self that would not restrain itself.

activation_trace.role: Inner discernment makes the gaze a possible site of prior moral recognition, not only a reflex.
Submission is the shared bodily shape whose voluntary or imposed timing remains open.
Awe-filled fear supplies the receptive disposition that can precede the final scene.
Fear visibly appearing on a person bridges inward anticipation and the outwardly humbled eyes.
Checking and restraining action supplies the voluntary counterpart to later enforced stillness.
The inward self of thought and alarm locates the contest beneath the visible gaze.
Inclination of the self supplies the mobile impulse that restraint checks and imposed humility finally arrests.

structural_cues: 79:40 grammatically links fear of standing before the Lord to restraining the self from inclination.
79:45 closes the warning around the one capable of awe-filled fear, while 79:37-39 supplies the opposed unrestrained outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ethical trajectories and a visible predicate of submission; I infer that timing distinguishes anticipatory humility from compulsory abasement. The focus most immediately describes the latter group, so the voluntary reading remains a contrastive resonance, not an identity claim.

changed_reading.before: خاشعة is automatically a commendatory sign of piety.
changed_reading.after: The same lowered form can mark either prior receptive restraint or, more directly here, the involuntary exposure of its absence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The خ ش ع image of low, inert earth enters a cosmography of raised vault, lower earth, and firmly set mountains. The eye can then be imagined as a once-prominent feature whose visual horizon and proud elevation have subsided into the ordered ground.

activation_trace.role: The physical eye supplies the small bodily landscape whose prominence can rise or sink.
Low, dormant earth converts humility from social demeanor into a topographic loss of elevation.
Raising establishes the vertical dimension against which the eye's subsidence is legible.
Height and elevation intensify the upper pole of the surrounding cosmography.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the groundlike destination of the humbled image.
The elevated solid mass supplies a contrasting image of retained prominence.
Firm settling turns the vertical contrast into a stable, imposed cosmic order.

structural_cues: 79:28 raises and orders the sky; 79:30 then spreads the earth with branchless د ح و as supporting motion; 79:32 fixes elevated mountains.
The focus branch inventory itself licenses an earthlike خاشعة image, so the cosmographic mapping returns to the predicate rather than floating free.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies low-earth imagery inside خ ش ع and a raised-versus-grounded cosmography; I miniaturize that vertical order onto the eye. The materially live alternative is ordinary bodily lowering with no landscape analogy.

changed_reading.before: The eyes display a social posture of deference.
changed_reading.after: Their prominence and visual horizon have subsided like low, dormant terrain beneath an imposed cosmic order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote ج ح م branch of a blazing or bulging eye, not the surface denotation of the blaze in 79:36. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit eyes and their submission, and downstream prose should present it only as a branch-level visual inversion: the spectacle takes the dominant ocular intensity while the human gaze retracts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَبْصَٰرُهَا names the human eyes, while خَٰشِعَةٌ removes their visual assertiveness.

activation_trace.role: The human ocular faculty supplies one side of the inversion.
Lowering and subjection strip intensity from the human gaze.
The blazing or bulging eye image transfers ocular intensity to the unveiled object.
Uncovering stages the transfer as an unavoidable visual confrontation.

changed_reading.before: Human eyes look toward an intense blaze.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, ocular intensity migrates to the unveiled blaze itself, leaving the human eyes visually dispossessed and lowered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because مقام in 79:40 ordinarily activates standing or station, whereas the cited ق و م branch is a fixed eye whose sight has gone. The reading remains tightly anchored to أَبْصَٰرُهَا and offers a concrete mode of visual defeat; downstream prose must label it an exploratory lexical echo, not the lexical meaning of مقام.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicates subjection directly of the eyes and therefore permits a model about loss of ocular agency.

activation_trace.role: Eyesight supplies the faculty whose agency can be arrested.
Stillness and lowering allow humility to be rendered as ocular immobilization.
A fixed standing eye bereft of sight supplies an extreme material image of visual agency stopped.
Fear appearing on the person keeps the remote eye image tied to the visible bodily state.

changed_reading.before: خاشعة means that functioning eyes deliberately look downward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the eyes may be fixed yet dispossessed of effective sight, their visual agency arrested before the standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 79:46 uses عَشِيَّةً temporally, while the activated ع ش و branch denotes weakened sight. It remains anchored through the focus's أَبْصَٰر and through the same verse's explicit seeing and compressed stay; downstream prose should qualify it as a cross-branch resonance in which temporal compression and visual uncertainty coincide, not redefine 'evening' as blindness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَبْصَٰرُهَا permits a visual reading of the final evening/daybreak contrast, and خَٰشِعَةٌ supplies the loss of perceptual mastery.

activation_trace.role: Eyesight anchors the temporal resonance in an explicit visual faculty.
Subjection renders the viewer's former scale of clarity and duration unreliable.
Actual seeing triggers the retrospective collapse of worldly duration.
Staying in a place supplies the duration that is suddenly judged vanishingly brief.
Weakness of sight gives the evening limit a contained perceptual echo.
Clear morning light supplies the opposite edge of the compressed temporal and visual interval.

changed_reading.before: The lowered eyes register only immediate fear.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, seeing humbles their whole scale of perception: a lifetime contracts between dim evening vision and clear morning light.

strongest_changes: The adjacent palpitating hearts turn the humbled eyes into the visible endpoint of an inside-to-outside bodily cascade.
The Pharaoh sequence recasts lowering as the reversal of self-exaltation and of discernment that refused a displayed sign.
The unveiled blaze makes humility compatible with unavoidable, overpowering sight rather than mere visual avoidance.
The final ethical contrast separates anticipatory self-restraint from involuntary abasement without collapsing them.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reorganized the two-word focus around vertical reversal, visibility, and the timing of submission, while its remote material branches kept live a terrain-like eye, a blaze that assumes ocular intensity, and a fixed eye stripped of sight.
remaining_uncertainties: The possessive link from the preceding hearts supports a body-wide circuit, but it does not prove a directional physiological cause.
The Pharaoh narrative supplies a powerful exemplar without proving that the anonymous eyes belong exclusively to his type.
The terrain, blazing-eye, fixed-eye, and twilight-sight readings are branch-valid but deliberately exploratory and should not displace the strong bodily lowering model.
